value.rationale: Constant-composition cyclic sequence reconstruction has a natural exact zero-error capacity not determined by the already-known total number of profiles. The bivariate formula simultaneously resolves all lengths and weights, and a sharp length threshold with parity-cubic stable capacity gives a reusable coding benchmark; the proof requires support-connected flow partition and a nontrivial length/weight constraint analysis rather than a parameter substitution. The full unweighted result and no-111 weighted subcase are expressly excluded from the new claim.
